defects.description: The debit is committed at line 17 before the credit runs. A crash, timeout or exception between line 17 and the credit at line 18/19 leaves the units removed from the source and never added to the destination, with no rollback.
The dry_run and priority parameters are accepted but never read. A caller that passes dry_run=True expects no stock change, but debit, credit and commit still run and the stock moves.

adjust() repeats the quantity check inline instead of using _validate_qty(), and does not truncate consistently. qty=0.5 passes this check, int(0.5) becomes 0 at apply_delta, no stock changes, yet the audit record at line 30 logs an adjustment of 0.5.

decoys.why_not_a_defect: _validate_qty is a small single-purpose helper called from transfer; extracting it is a deliberate single place for the positive-quantity rule.
on_hand is a thin delegation method that exposes the public read API without adding logic; there is no duplicated behaviour.
